audit.whatIsWrong: 9 misgenders across tldr, loading, dosFull[1].t, dontsFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[10].t, report[11].t call Leona 'his'/'him'. Leona is female.
audit.why: The owner is 'you'; a stray pronoun refers to the enemy, so a misgendered Leona reads as a wrong-champion template leak.
audit.corrected: Swapped his->her in all flagged fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side in the full layer disagrees with the matching content win[N] for this matchup: rows 0-3 say 'Leona' while win[0-3]='Karma'; rows 4-5 say the generic 'Skill' while win[4-5]='Leona'; row 6 says 'Skill' while win[6]='Karma'. The packet's own levelChart also matches win[] exactly, and phases[].why text (RQ poke lead, jungler ganks converting) already describes KARMA winning those early rows — the why and the side field argue with each other on the same row.
audit.why: A reader sees one verdict in the chart color/side and the opposite verdict in the sentence under it. This is the exact 189-row defect pattern the run brief warns about.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 side values to match win[N] (already correct per packet+content). Rewrote phases[4].why and phases[5].why, which described a Karma advantage while the row now correctly reads Leona, to explain her real level-6/first-item engage spike grounded in the kit (E-Q-R chain, tank-item-enabled engage). Rows 0-3 and row 6 needed side fixed only — their why text already matched the target side, per the exception in the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad text pasted under titles about tethering her dash and trading her all-in respectively.
audit.why: Neither body actually explains the titled mechanic.
audit.corrected: Replaced both with real E-specific content (Zenith Blade's immobilize+dash and the E-Q-R all-in threat).

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Leona's combo opens with an auto-attack reset on Shield of Daybreak (Q) — not reflected anywhere on the page.
audit.why: The wind-up before the empowered auto lands is the actual dodge window, not the Q cast itself.
audit.corrected: Added as dosFull[3] via before:null (no prior 4th entry existed).
